job_description:
Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a Lead, Data Science (ML / AI / GenAI), Raritan, NJ or near a Johnson & Johnson office in Switzerland (Zug), Belgium (Beerse / Brussels), or the United States. This position may require up to 20% travel.

Per our J&J Flex Policy, the expectation for this position is to work in the nearest Johnson and Johnson office 3-4 days per week and work from home 1-2 days per week.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/.

Enterprise Quality is a comprehensive organization within J&J that focuses on ensuring the highest standards of quality & compliance. It encompasses a Quality Operations division that handles Computer System Validation (CSV), QMS Management, and Commercial Quality Shared Services, including specialized support for Transportation Operations and Temperature Control. Additionally, it includes a Transformation Office dedicated to steering strategic imperatives and enhancing the Quality & Compliance organization's strategy through initiatives like Data Strategy, Automated Product Release, and Digitalization of Quality Management Systems. The group further comprises a Data & Digital Strategy function tasked with developing and executing a holistic digital and data strategy to improve quality and compliance, covering areas such as Data Foundations, AI/ML & IoT technologies, Quality & Compliance Innovation, and Digital Assets validation. To facilitate the deployment of these strategic initiatives, the group employs two Deployment Offices for the MedTech and Innovative Medicines segments and maintains a global presence through three regional leaders managing operations in Asia Pacific (ASPAC), Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Americas.

The Transformation Office ensures efficient, measurable, and value-driven execution of the Q&C strategy, transformation portfolio, annual business planning cycles, and operational support for the office of Enterprise Quality VP.

As part of the Transformation Office, the Data Science (AI / ML / GenAI) Lead plays a pivotal role in supporting the integration and operationalization of Data Science (AI / ML / GenAI) within the Q&C organization. Reporting to the Director of Emerging Technology, this individual is tasked with executing key initiatives, collaborating closely with data and analytics teams, and ensuring the effective deployment of technologies such as AI / ML / GenAI among others. The role demands a proactive approach to innovation, focusing on enhancing Q&C’s digital transformation journey and aligning with strategic business objectives.

· Executes key initiatives for integrating and operationalizing emerging technologies such as AI/ML/GenAI within the Q&C organization.

· Collaborates closely with the Director, Emerging Technologies to align and deliver on Q&C's strategy for leveraging emerging technologies.

· Supports the deployment of new technologies to enhance automation, predictive analytics, and insight-generation across business processes.

· Given the nature of Q&C, there’s a specific focus on Generative AI in the area of Regulations Monitoring and Controlled Content (Document & Training Management).

· Identifies innovative technology solutions to accelerate Q&C toward strategic business objectives.

· Assists in the management of technology projects, ensuring alignment with strategic goals, optimal resource allocation, and risk minimization.

· Provides technical expertise to infuse new technologies into ongoing transformation initiatives, increasing the transformational value proposition.

· Facilitates the integration of emerging technologies into Q&C processes, maintaining a focus on innovation and digital transformation.

· Collaborate with other staff within Transformation Office group to ensure each function is executed in an efficient manner

· Ensure timely reports of status and metrics as required by the Transformation Office organization

job_description:
Analytics Process Architect - Artificial Intelligence Business Integration

Overview

FM Global is a leading property insurer of the world's largest businesses, providing more than one-third of FORTUNE 1000-size companies with engineering-based risk management and property insurance solutions. FM Global helps clients maintain continuity in their business operations by drawing upon state-of-the-art loss-prevention engineering and research, risk management skills and support services, tailored risk transfer capabilities, and superior financial strength. To do so, we rely on a dynamic, culturally diverse group of employees, working in more than 100 countries, in a variety of challenging roles.

Responsibilities

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Analytics Process Architect to join our team, with a special focus on integrating artificial intelligence (AI) features within our technology products and business workflows. The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding and documenting detailed business processes, identifying technical dependencies, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation. This role requires an understanding of conventional and generative AI technologies and their practical applications in FM Global business context, as well as strong analytical and communication skills to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. The Analytics Process Architect will play a key role in driving innovation and efficiency by leveraging AI to enhance our products and streamline our processes, ultimately contributing to the company's strategic goals and competitive edge.

Expected Results

Clear and Comprehensive Documentation:

• Produce detailed and precise documentation of business requirements for AI features.
• Ensure requirements are aligned with business objectives and stakeholder expectations.
Accurate Identification of Technical Dependencies:

• Identify and document technical dependencies related to AI capability implementation.
• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure all dependencies are understood and managed effectively.
Effective Stakeholder Communication:

• Maintain open and clear communication channels with stakeholders, including business leaders, technical teams, and end-users.
• Facilitate meetings, workshops, and discussions to gather insights and feedback.
Implementation of AI Features:

• Support the coordination of AI-related projects to ensure timely and within-scope delivery.
• Work closely with development teams to monitor progress and address any issues or roadblocks.
Enhanced Business Workflows:

• Identify opportunities for AI to streamline and optimize existing business workflows.
• Propose and implement AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency and productivity.
Alignment with Strategic Goals:

• Ensure AI initiatives are aligned with the company's strategic objectives and contribute to competitive advantage.
• Provide insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making.
Risk Management and Mitigation:

• Identify potential risks and challenges associated with AI integration and develop mitigation strategies.
• Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, ethical standards, and corporate governance for AI initiatives.
Continuous Improvement:

• Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in AI technology and business analysis practices.
• Proactively suggest improvements and innovations based on industry best practices and emerging technologies.
User Training and Support:

• Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users to ensure smooth adoption of new AI features.
• Provide ongoing support and address any user concerns or questions.
Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree required
• 10+ years of business process and/or business analysis experience
• 3+ years of experience in project management
• Previous experience working with machine learning, predictive analytics, or artificial intelligence solutions
TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

• Strong understanding of property insurance business concepts and processes
• Expert knowledge of techniques and tools utilized in functional design, business processes improvement, and data analysis
• AI literate: able to understand and articulate artificial intelligence concepts, challenges, and capabilities
• Data literate: able to understand and articulate data challenges and impacts on dependent analytics
SOFT SKILLS

• Proven ability to multi-task and establish priorities
• Excellent interpersonal, oral/written communication and organizational skills
• Proven ability to provide direction to others and influence decisions made
• Proven ability to negotiate with business and information technology groups
Compensation, Grade, and Job Title will be determined based on qualifications, experience, and technical skillset.

The position is eligible to participate in FM Global's comprehensive Total Rewards program that includes an incentive plan, generous health and well-being programs, a 401(k) and pension plan, career development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, flexible work, paid time off allowances and much more.

FM Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce.

Locations: Sales - CA - San Francisco, United States of America, San Francisco, CaliforniaDirector, Generative AI Platform - Agents and Tooling - People Leader (Remote Eligible)

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Director, AI Platforms to help us build the foundations of our enterprise AI Capabilities. In this role you will work on developing generic platform services to support applications powered by Generative AI. You will develop SDKs and APIs to build agents, information retrieval and to build models as a service for powering generative AI workflows such as optimizing LLMs via RAG.

Additionally you will manage end-to-end coordination with operations and manage creation of high quality curated datasets and productionizing of models along with working with applied research and product teams to identify and prioritize ongoing and upcoming services.

Examples of what you’ll do:
• Develop abstracted platform services to support applications powered by Generative AI
• Develop SDKs and APIs for our user community to power a wide range of applications such as information retrieval, fraud detection, AI Assistants, recommendations on our Gen AI platform.
• Design and build RAG service platform orchestrations including prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases, API Grounding
• Build out a Prompt management service via cross organizational partnerships
• Stay up-to-date with latest advancements in operationalization of machine learning and GenAI Technologies
• Design and implement capabilities to support MLOps for foundation models.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or C/C++
• At least 5 years of experience designing and building and deploying enterprise AI or ML applications.
• At least 3 years of experience implementing full lifecycle ML automation using MLOps(scalable development to deployment of complex data science workflows)
• At least 4 years of experience leading teams developing Machine Learning solutions
• At least 5 years of people management experience.
• At least 1 year with LLM based conversational AI systems

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with a focus on modern AI techniques.
• Strong problem solving and analytical skills with the ability to work independently with ownership, and as a part of a team with a strong sense of responsibilities.
• Experience designing large-scale distributed platforms and/or systems in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Experience architecting cloud systems for security, availability, performance, scalability, and cost.
• Experience with delivering very large models through the MLOps life cycle from exploration to serving
• Ability to move fast in an environment with ambiguity at times, and with competing priorities and deadlines. Experience at tech and product-driven companies/startups preferred.
• Ability to iterate rapidly with researchers and engineers to improve a product experience while building the core components of a Generative AI Platform.
• Experience with one or multiple areas of AI technology stack including prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases/knowledge bases, LLM hosting, advanced RAG and fine-tuning.
• Experience working with applications that leverage LLMs and vertical integration with enterprise applications

job_description:
(San Diego, CA)

Mirador is a next-generation precision medicine company focused on immunology and inflammation. The company’s Mirador360 TM precision development engine leverages the latest advances in human genetics and cutting-edge data science to rapidly advance new precision medicines for patients living with chronic immune-mediated inflammatory and fibrotic diseases. Launched in 2024, Mirador has raised over $400 million from leading life sciences investors and is based in San Diego, CA.

Summary

We seek a talented Associate Director, AI to report to the Executive Director, AI & Machine Learning and collaborate on development of deep neural networks (DNNs) and large language models (LLMs) leveraging multi-modal data (genetics, omics, EHR/text) to drive new insights and therapeutic hypotheses. In this position, the individual will be responsible to build, train, test, and maintain predictive, interpretable, and generalizable data models. The position will be partnered cross-functionally to align on standard assumptions and tools used to estimate future outcomes and build mechanisms that communicate to stakeholders when opportunities are identified.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and fine-tune large-scale neural network models, with a strong emphasis on language models.
• Explore state-of-the-art techniques in NLP, transfer learning, and generative AI to enhance our capabilities.
• Participate in and oversight of scientific report writing. Presentation of methods, results, and conclusions to a publishable standard.
• Communicate findings in multiple settings (including 1:1, group and project meetings).
• Strong at building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Job Summary of Senior AI Systems Engineer:

The Senior AI Systems Engineer offers the opportunity to work with a team of highly skilled professionals on creating unique and game-changing products

Capital One's primary mission is to create AI systems that are reliable, trustworthy, and human-centered in the banking industry. Capital One is well-known for its use of machine learning which has transformed the customer experience, providing real-time, intelligent, and automated services. Capital One platforms cater to customer needs, including answering inquiries, alerting them to unusual charges, and creating a humanized and straightforward banking experience. Capital One is uniquely positioned to harness the benefits of AI through its investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms. The company prides itself on developing world-class engineering and applied science teams, which provide breakthrough products and high-performance AI infrastructure. Capital One will continue to lead the industry in AI technology, offering scalable solutions to their customers and businesses. Be a part of Capital One team and help reimagine how banking works through emerging AI capabilities.

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Systems Engineer to join our team, who will be responsible for maintaining APIs and SDKs that enable scaling AI models. Your role with us involves developing systems that provide access to LLMs and FMs via our public cloud infrastructure. We'll collaborate with you to come up with key API services and products vital for customer-facing applications that are delivered in real-time.

Responsibilities of Senior AI Systems Engineer:
• Create, construct, and release reliable core APIs and software development kits to access our LLMs and proprietary FMs, which include training, refining, and initiating routines, as well as orchestration SDKs.
• Create APIs that are capable of scaling to accommodate a growing number of users and data sources without sacrificing performance.
• Develop application-specific interfaces that capitalize on the capabilities of LLMs and FMs to enhance customer and associate satisfaction.
• Make it possible for our users to create innovative GenAI capabilities.
• It is imperative to establish reliable protocols and systems that can keep track of API access patterns and operational health.
• Work in close partnership with researchers to create reliable, ethical, and secure AI systems that minimize risk and maximize benefits.

• Completion of an undergraduate program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical discipline
• The role requires a proficiency in creating and executing data-intensive projects that leverage distributed computing and cache optimization practices, acquired through a minimum of six years of experience
• A minimum of 6 years of coding proficiency in Java, Go, Python, or Scala is vital for the job
• The candidate must have had prior expertise in developing, refining, and streamlining training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks for a minimum of one year

Preferred Qualifications of Senior AI Systems Engineer:
• Expertise in constructing and implementing scalable AI products or platforms that cater to millions of users for NLP, speech, computer vision, and recommendation systems.
• Having the agility to operate effectively in a complex and uncertain environment.
• Candidates with a background in tech and product-based startups are strongly encouraged to apply.
• The skill to collaborate with researchers and engineers, allowing for rapid iterations in enhancing the product while concurrently building fundamental competencies.
• Experience in deploying sophisticated neural network models in demanding production settings.
• Skilled in ensuring the protection of APIs, maintaining system observability for improved performance, and implementing best practices to safeguard data privacy.

Overview:

Spotter, named one of TIME100's Most Influential Companies this year, empowers top YouTube creators to accelerate their business and unleash their full creative potential by giving them access to the capital, knowledge, and community they need to succeed at scale. As the top provider of creator-friendly growth capital, Spotter tailors our investments to meet the unique needs of each creator we partner with, giving them the freedom to create without compromise.

Creators are free to reinvest their funds however they choose, from hiring a team, to building their own production studios, and everything in between, all while maintaining total control over their catalogs, their channels, and their future earnings. In addition to funding, Spotter provides creators with in-depth data insights into the performance of their existing content, enabling them to leverage the full value of their library, as well as the value of future uploads and how they can improve performance in the future.

Featured in Forbes, Fast Company, Variety, Axios, and more, Spotter has already deployed over $850 million to YouTube creators to reinvest in themselves and accelerate their growth. Spotter has licensed content that consists of over 725,000 videos, which generate 88 billion monthly watch-time minutes. With our curated premium video catalog, we deliver a unique scaled media solution to Advertisers and Ad Agencies that is transparent, efficient, and 100% brand safe.

What You’ll Do

Help revolutionize how Spotter uses artificial intelligence to provide the most creative ideation workflows on the planet. This groundbreaking role combines AI, machine learning, and cultural analytics to explore new directions for pushing the boundaries of idea generation and storytelling. As a key member of our growing team, you'll leverage cutting-edge AI tools to drive engaging, data-driven content across diverse platforms, with a focus on understanding and optimizing YouTube content at scale.
• Work closely with the content generation team to seamlessly integrate AI tools into the ideation process, elevating both creativity and overall strategy.
• Prototype and refine AI applications designed to predict content performance, gauge user engagement, and identify emerging creative trends.
• Utilize extensive datasets to derive actionable insights, informing and shaping creative strategies to boost content personalization and relevance.
• Develop and refine AI-driven prompts to enhance content quality and consistency, ensuring our creative outputs are both innovative and impactful.
• Analyze and categorize YouTube content to identify and exploit creative genres, formats, and elements that maximize viewer engagement and performance.
• Perform statistical analyses to assess the effectiveness of AI-enhanced content strategies on expanding audience reach and improving retention rates.
• Present innovative product solutions and strategic insights to senior management and key stakeholders, advocating for data-driven approaches in content development.
• Stay up to date on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning, incorporating new technologies and methodologies to stay ahead of industry trends.

Who You Are:
• You have substantial experience in AI and machine learning, particularly in applications involving NLP and large language models.
• Your background includes working with large-scale data environments and you possess strong analytical skills combined with a creative mindset.
• You are proficient in Python libraries and frameworks relevant to AI and ML (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.)
• Your experience includes developing and leading innovative projects, with a proven track record of leveraging technology to enhance content creativity and audience engagement.
• You demonstrate a deep understanding of content ecosystems, particularly digital and social media platforms like YouTube.

Skills and Qualifications:
• Expertise in prompt engineering and generative AI models.
• Experience with tools and platforms for data visualization and analysis to convey complex information succinctly.
• Strong presentation skills, capable of conveying technical insights and strategic vision to non-technical stakeholders.
• A curiosity for continuous learning and a keen interest in exploring new technological frontiers within the AI and content generation fields.

• Dental & vision insurance
• 401(k) matching
• Stock options
• Complimentary gym access
• Autonomy and upward mobility
• Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture, where your voice matters.

At Acadia Healthcare, we are at the forefront of technological innovation, leveraging AI to solve real-world problems. Our team is composed of thinkers, creators, and innovators dedicated to making a significant impact in our industry. We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge AI solutions.

As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying artificial intelligence systems that are at the core of our product offerings. You will work closely with a team of data engineers and business stakeholders to create AI models that improve our products and services. Your work will directly contribute to the advancement of our technology and its application in real-world scenarios.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Design, develop, and maintain AI models and algorithms for various applications, including but not limited to machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and identify AI solutions that can enhance product capabilities.
• Conduct data processing and analysis to prepare datasets for training and evaluation of AI models.
• Implement best practices in AI model development, including model validation, testing, and optimization to ensure high performance and scalability.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest AI research and technologies to propose innovative approaches for solving complex problems.
• Document and present model development processes, results, and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Contribute to the company's AI strategy and roadmap, identifying opportunities for leveraging AI to achieve business goals.

• Complies with organizational policies, procedures, performance improvement initiatives and maintains organizational and industry policies regarding confidentiality
• Communicate clearly and effectively to person(s) receiving services and their family members, guests, and other members of the health care team
• Develops constructive and cooperative working relationships with others and maintains them over time
• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members
• Maintains regular and predictable attendance

• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and familiarity with AI and data science frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).

job_description:
About the Company: One of our well-established Start-up clients in Palo Alto, CA are seeking an experienced Lead AI Trust and Safety Research Scientist to spearhead our efforts in developing safe, ethical, and reliable AI systems. In this role, you will work closely with our product and research teams to ensure our foundation models, including large language models and multimodal systems, adhere to the highest standards of safety, honesty, and helpfulness. Your work will be crucial in shaping the responsible development and deployment of AI technologies that can positively impact millions of lives across India and beyond.

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with the product team to define and implement safety aspects that ensure our AI models deliver helpful, honest, and harmless outputs.
• Lead the development and implementation of advanced safety techniques for large language and multimodal models, including but not limited to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).
• Conduct thorough red teaming exercises to identify potential vulnerabilities and ensure our models do not generate harmful or undesirable high-quality outputs.
• Design and oversee the generation of high-quality synthetic data for fine-tuning models to improve safety and performance.
• Lead research initiatives in AI safety, focusing on models with 10s and 100s of billions of parameters.
• Develop innovative methodologies for evaluating and mitigating risks associated with large-scale AI models.
• Stay abreast of the latest developments in AI ethics and safety, and contribute to the broader scientific community through publications and conference presentations.
• Mentor and guide junior researchers in AI safety principles and practices.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate safety measures throughout the AI development pipeline.

Qualifications:
• M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with a focus on AI safety and ethics.
• 4+ years of experience in AI research, with a strong emphasis on trust and safety aspects of large language models and multimodal systems.
• Demonstrated expertise in implementing advanced safety techniques such as RLHF, DPO, and PPO for foundation models.
• Proven track record of building or fine-tuning models with 10s and 100s of billions of parameters.
• Strong background in red teaming methodologies and adversarial testing for AI systems.
• Experience in generating and working with high-quality synthetic data for model fine-tuning.
• In-depth understanding of ethical considerations in AI development and deployment.
• Excellent programming skills, particularly in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.
• Strong publication record in top-tier AI conferences and journals, specifically in areas related to AI safety and ethics.
• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Experience leading research teams and mentoring junior researchers.
• Familiarity with relevant regulatory frameworks and industry standards for AI ethics and safety.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Strategic Analyst & AI Specialist will provide analysis for business decision making, provide options for consideration and make recommendations on strategy for Operations and Supply Chain at MiMedx.

Through execution of analysis, this position will investigate artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and data analytics, and apply these technologies to optimize decision making. Analysis will include trending of supply chain materials, process performance in manufacturing and customer behavior for supply planning, cost optimization, inventory control and capacity management.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Overall Duties:
• Collect, clean, and preprocess supply chain data from various sources, including ERP systems, sensors, and IoT devices.
• Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and forecasting techniques to improve demand planning, inventory management, and logistics optimization.
• Utilize statistical analysis and machine learning techniques to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in supply chain data.
• Lead the development and implementation of data science strategies to drive business growth and innovation within Cloud environments.
• Deploy AI solutions into production environments and integrate them with existing supply chain systems and workflows.
• Conduct thorough testing and validation of AI models to ensure accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
• Collaborate with IT teams to ensure seamless integration and interoperability with enterprise systems.
• Conduct research on state-of-the-art AI and ML techniques applicable to supply chain management.
• Develop and prototype AI algorithms and models tailored to specific supply chain & manufacturing challenges.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
• Monitor the performance of AI-driven supply chain solutions and continuously evaluate their effectiveness.
• Identify opportunities for improvement and optimization through advanced analytics and algorithm tuning.
• Work closely with stakeholders to gather feedback and iterate on AI models to address evolving business needs.
• Stay abreast of emerging trends and best practices in AI, ML, and supply chain management.
• Share knowledge and insights with colleagues through training sessions, workshops, and technical presentations.
• Partner with stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop dashboards and reports to monitor business performance and inform decision-making, utilizing Azure Data Explorer, Power BI, or similar tools.
• Clearly communicate the benefits and limitations of AI/ML models and capabilities to a variety of stakeholders.

• Bachelor of Science in engineering, Master’s degree in Business, or equivalent
• Proven experience (3+ years) in developing AI/ML solutions for supply chain optimization in manufacturing & regulated industries.

Expert level knowledge of:
• Statistical analysis, optimization techniques, and time series forecasting methods.
• Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) is desirable.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
• Knowledge of 21 CRF Part 11 compliance, GxP & GAMPS

The work is typically performed in a normal office environment. Role routinely uses standard office equipment. Travel will be less than 25%.

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Director, AI Platforms to help us build the foundations of our enterprise AI Capabilities. In this role you will work on developing generic platform services to support applications powered by Generative AI. You will develop SDKs and APIs to build agents, information retrieval and to build models as a service for powering generative AI workflows such as optimizing LLMs via RAG.

Additionally you will manage end-to-end coordination with operations and manage creation of high quality curated datasets and productionizing of models along with working with applied research and product teams to identify and prioritize ongoing and upcoming services.

• Develop SDKs and APIs for our user community to power a wide range of applications such as information retrieval, fraud detection, AI Assistants, recommendations on our Gen AI platform.

• Build out a Prompt management service via cross organizational partnerships
• Stay up-to-date with latest advancements in operationalization of machine learning and GenAI Technologies
• Design and implement capabilities to support MLOps for foundation models.

Join our growing team at Vetcove, and help us transform how veterinarians buy the supplies they need to keep America's pets healthy. Vetcove's eCommerce and mobile platforms enable veterinary practices to compare and buy from all of their vendors in one place. Our community of more than 17,000 veterinary hospitals employs tens of thousands of veterinarians, and delivers care to many millions of animals every year across all 50 states. We’re a growing team on a mission to modernize the $50B+ animal health industry. Simply put, Vetcove helps veterinary organizations spend more time giving care, and less time shopping and comparing across vendors to supply their practices. Vetcove is a Y Combinator and venture-backed growth stage company with notable investors in Silicon Valley and NYC. We're looking for exceptionally talented and passionate people to join our growing team.

About Our Team

We move lightning-fast in an industry that was previously slow to adopt technology. As Vetcove quickly expands its offerings to better serve veterinary groups and their pet parents, we’re quickly growing our engineering team to keep pace with the rapid expansion of our business, while maintaining exceptional code quality and system integrity.

You’ll have an opportunity to work closely with end users, handle large scale infrastructure challenges, and everything in between.

About the Position

As an AI integration software engineer, you will be responsible for integrating cutting-edge LLM models from providers like OpenAI into our existing features to enhance our products' capabilities and deliver a better user experience.

Tools We Use:

We primarily use python and the Django web framework for powering our backend APIs and internal tooling.

Tech Stack: Python, Django, Elasticsearch, Postgres

Other Tools: Git, Docker

Primary responsibilities include:
• Evaluating and selecting the most appropriate AI models for our products based on our business needs and requirements.
• Developing and maintaining AI-powered application features using Python
• Testing and validating the performance of AI models in real-world scenarios and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
• Staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI technology and identifying opportunities for innovation within our products.
• Fine-tuning, evaluating, and iterating on LLM models in production
• Work directly with our CTO and engineering team, as well as across other functions to continuously evolve our platform and products

You should have
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in software development, including experience in building a professionally successful production application in a modern web framework
• Strong knowledge of AI models, including natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL)
• A passion for staying up to date with the latest developments in AI
• Strong engineering fundamentals with various back-end technologies
• Ability to design new features around data models with accuracy, security, and performance in mind
• A positive attitude and one-for-all team mentality

If you are passionate about AI and have experience in integrating AI models into existing software systems, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Note that this role does not require designing and implementing new machine learning models, but rather integrating and fine-tuning existing models currently available in the market.

About Robin AI

Robin AI is on a mission to revolutionize the legal industry by simplifying contracts and making law accessible to everyone. We utilize cutting-edge machine learning and contract software, enhancing traditional legal services and bringing together experts in engineering, AI, and law. Robin AI has recently raised $26m in Series B funding and has seen an impressive 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months.

We're looking for passionate, resourceful and collaborative people to join Robin. If you're motivated about leveraging technology to make essential business services more accessible, come join us!

About this role

Robin AI is looking for LLM Research Engineers to join a new Research and Development function in the company. Today our product uses large language models to help automate legal work. You will work to ensure that we continue to be at the cutting edge of LLM capabilities by working on LLM fine-tuning, retrieval augmented generation, and other technologies, and by identifying new possible LLM functionality we can build into our product.

You will report directly to the CTO and co-founder as part of a small, agile and cross-functional R&D team.

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Director, AI Platforms to help us build the foundations of our enterprise AI Capabilities. In this role you will work on developing generic platform services to support applications powered by Generative AI. You will develop SDKs and APIs to build agents, information retrieval and to build models as a service for powering generative AI workflows such as optimizing LLMs via RAG.

• Build out a Prompt management service via cross organizational partnerships

job_title: Senior Director AI/ML Engineering, Responsible Use of AI Program - Remote
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Optum AI team is focused on delivering AI-ML solutions for the highest impact and business prioritized problems. Across UnitedHealth Group, we are transforming the health care journey through responsible AI/ML innovation that; simplifies operations and reduce administrative burden; improves the member and provider experience; and brings insights and information to clinicians. Driving Responsible use of AI across the enterprise to ensure safe deployment of AI models into practice is a key focus of Optum AI as well as enabling democratization of AI by creating platform capabilities and frameworks for developers across the enterprise.

As artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) solutions continue to evolve, we are committed to assessing and improving our AI/ML practices continuously based on our own learning, industry best practices and regulatory guidance. Our Responsible Use of AI program, which includes the Machine Learning Review Board, supports all ML teams across UnitedHealth Group (UHG) with a holistic, structured, and cross-disciplined review of AI.

In this leadership role, the Senior Director Data Science for the Responsible Use of AI Program (RUAI), you will be collaborating with other data science and AI-ML leaders to develop technical standards for Responsible AI development and evaluation and translate them into action through the implementation of ML model metrics and monitoring tools. You will apply your expertise in reviewing, assessing, and testing AI used across the organization through several workstreams. You will implement a framework for red-teaming and conducting independent assessment and testing of internal AI and support M & A diligence efforts. You will participate in internal AI governance processes by reviewing internal or supplier-provided AI and oversee external/independent assessments of internal AI. As a key leader in the Responsible Use of AI program, you will influence across the enterprise by interacting with data science leaders and functional business executives to educate and advise on key concepts related to responsible use of AI. This role is essential to the company's success as the RUAI program has increasing requirements for standards based on emerging technology and to meet the increasing market demand.

As the Senior Director, you will drive the implementation and adoption of state-of-the-art evaluation metrics for Generative AI and other modern AI methods as well as drive the frameworks and evaluation process for measuring the safety, accuracy, and fairness of ML model implementation. You will provide leadership to, and will be accountable for, the adoption and consistent use of standardized AI measurement and monitoring frameworks and tools. This role reports to the Director of the Responsible Use of AI Program and working with the UHG Chief AI Officer.

To be successful in this role, you will bring solid analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance innovation and pragmatism to drive the team and solutions forward, possess an educator's voice to support organizational growth and maturity, and promote a keen passion for learning and continuous improvement based on the latest AI/ML trends and research.

Please note that this role is not intended for professionals performing the following work: less complex analysis on small data sets; rules-based algorithmic or descriptive analytics; development of big data infrastructure.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Research and develop new methods to build, test and monitor AI consistent with UHG guiding principles for Responsible Use of AI (quality, explainability, fairness, security, accountability, and continuous improvement)
• Design and build new tools to implement AI performance and fairness testing and monitoring in partnership with legal, compliance, and engineering teams
• Play a key leadership role in the Machine Learning Review Board to provide direct oversight and review of proposed AI from teams across Optum, UHG and UHC (UnitedHealthcare)
• Conduct Red Team/adversarial reviews of AI used by UHC, Optum or UHG
• Identify and manage third party AI assessors (e.g., consultants) as they perform third-party reviews of UHG AI
• Lead AI due diligence in support of M&A efforts
• Manage a small, dedicated team with the ability to utilize development engineers, SMEs, and other resources to achieve goals

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:
• Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related STEM discipline
• 12 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, or Analytics with 8 years of experience in AI/ML solution development
• 8 years of expertise in various AI/ML techniques, such as deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, recommender systems, reinforcement learning, large language models, etc.
• 4 years of experience in Python for data analysis and AI/ML development
• 4 years of experience leading and managing (direct reports and dotted line) AI/ML teams including driving projects, from ideation to delivery and evaluation
• 2 years of experience evaluating the performance and fairness of AI following internal or external guidelines for responsible development and use of AI

Preferred Qualifications:
• Ph.D. in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or statistics
• Proven track record of delivering high-impact AI/ML solutions for real-world problems and use cases
• Experience in establishing and enforcing AI/ML best practices, standards, and ethics through development of technical frameworks and tools
• Background in Healthcare (AI)
• Portfolio of AI/ML publications, patents, or awards
• Experience in AI or data governance
• Experience in working with cross-functional and distributed teams in a global and diverse environment
• Experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing AI/ML talent

SimVentions is a 100% employee-owned business and has consistently been voted one of Virginia's Best Places to Work. Sr Distinguished Engineer, Generative AI Systems

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Systems, to help us build the foundations of our enterprise AI Capabilities. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, whether that’s designing robust, secure infrastructure, building large-scale distributed training clusters, deploying LLMs on GPU instances for real-time use cases, or supporting cutting-edge AI research and development, all in our public cloud infrastructure. You will work with a team of AI engineers and researchers to envision the target state of our capabilities while helping to design and implement key services. Examples of projects you will work on include:
• Design and build fault-tolerant infrastructure to support long-running large-scale training tasks reliably despite failure of individual nodes, using containers and check-pointing libraries.
• Design and build infrastructure for serving large ML models, in our public cloud.
• Deploy a thousand-node training cluster optimizing storage and networking stack, with tightly coupled training pipelines to take advantage of multiple parallelism strategies, in our public cloud.
• Design and implement benchmarks to measure the performance of software systems within AI capabilities and make recommendations on technology selection
• Develop applications that leverage LLMs and FMs.
• Design and implement capabilities to support MLOps for foundation models.

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
• At least 9 years of experience designing and building distributed computing HPC and large-scale ML systems
• At least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms in Python or C/C++
• At least 3 years of experience with the full ML development lifecycle using AI and ML frameworks and public cloud.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with a focus on modern AI techniques.
• Experience designing large-scale distributed platforms and/or systems in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Experience architecting cloud systems for security, availability, performance, scalability, and cost.
• Experience with delivering very large models through the MLOps life cycle from exploration to serving.
• Experience with building GPU clusters in the public cloud with tightly-coupled storage and networking.
• Experience with the complete stack for distributed training of large models including ML compilers, distributed training frameworks, and ML development frameworks such as Pytorch, Tensorflow, Lightning etc.
• Experience with one or multiple areas of AI technology stack including prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases/knowledge bases, LLM hosting and fine-tuning.
• Authored research publications in top peer-reviewed conferences, or industry-recognized contributions in the space of neural networks, distributed training and SysML.

Navina is a fast-growing digital health SaaS company that’s on a mission to enhance the primary care experience by transforming the way physicians interact with patient data. Job Summary of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:

This position will be tasked with creating products that take advantage of the latest developments in AI, making it an exciting time to be a part of this team

At the heart of Capital One's values is creating trustworthy, dependable, and human-led AI systems in the banking industry. Capital One has been leading the industry in its use of machine learning to produce intelligent, automated customer experiences in real-time. Capital One platforms are designed to provide personalized banking services that address customers' inquiries, inform them of unusual charges, and provide a human touch. Capital One is well-equipped to realize AI's potential, and its investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, coupled with its world-class applied science and engineering teams, have provided breakthrough products and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. Joining Capital One allows you to unleash the full potential of emerging AI capabilities, thereby reimagining banking for the future.

We need an experienced Senior Generative AI Product Engineer to help develop and maintain APIs and SDKs as part of our Enterprise AI team. Your responsibility involves building systems enabling public access to LLMs and FMs through our cloud environment. Collaborating with a team of expert AI engineers and researchers, you will design and implement important API products and services for user-facing applications operating in real-time.

Responsibilities of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:
• Establish, erect, and put into operation well-managed primary APIs and SDKs that provide access to our LLMs and proprietary FMs, which includes training, fine-tuning, and prompting exercises, together with orchestration SDKs.
• Implement caching mechanisms to improve API performance and reduce latency when processing high volumes of data.
• Leverage LLMs and FMs to craft specialized interfaces that deliver a personalized experience to your customers and associates.
• Facilitate the creation of new GenAI capabilities by our users.
• Ensuring API access patterns and operational health are maintained at optimum levels entails deploying tools and processes that can extract the necessary metrics and analyze trends.
• Devise and test approaches for model validation, performance monitoring, and risk assessment to enhance model accuracy and robustness.

Basic Qualifications of Senior Generative AI Product Engineer:
• Completing a program of study in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field lasting a minimum of four years and leading to a Bachelor's degree

Locations: VA - McLean, United States of America, McLean, VirginiaSr Distinguished Engineer, Generative AI Systems - (Remote- Eligible)

Sr Distinguished Engineer, Generative AI Systems

Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Distinguished Engineer, AI Systems, to help us build the foundations of our enterprise AI Capabilities. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, whether that’s designing robust, secure infrastructure, building large-scale distributed training clusters, deploying LLMs on GPU instances for real-time use cases, or supporting cutting-edge AI research and development, all in our public cloud infrastructure. You will work with a team of AI engineers and researchers to envision the target state of our capabilities while helping to design and implement key services. Examples of projects you will work on include:
• Design and build fault-tolerant infrastructure to support long-running large-scale training tasks reliably despite failure of individual nodes, using containers and check-pointing libraries.
• Design and build infrastructure for serving large ML models, in our public cloud.
• Deploy a thousand-node training cluster optimizing storage and networking stack, with tightly coupled training pipelines to take advantage of multiple parallelism strategies, in our public cloud.
